cases.name: Mamta Kafle Bhatt
cases.about: She was a beloved member of the Nepalese community and she worked as a registered nurse in the medical surgical unit at UVA Health Prince William Medical Center in Manassas, VA.
cases.narrative: He is accused of killing her in their home, then dragging her body outside, likely on 7/30/2024. He was captured on camera driving his Tesla – on some occasions during the night – disposing of trash bags in dumpsters and trash compactors. Video camera footage showed Bhatt dropping a bag inside a donation bin – prosecutors say police told them found inside the bag was a bathmat with blood on it.
